description: This source file is a server-side module for a SvelteKit application, handling data loading and actions related to task management in a Django REST API backend. It includes logic to fetch, transform, and submit task data, as well as handling various task operations like create, update, delete, and status changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches tasks and related data from the API, processes and transforms the data for frontend use, including handling filters, pagination, and different view modes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new task by sending data to the API, transforming form data into the appropriate API format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task's details via API, based on form data, including handling related entities.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks a task as completed by updating its status via API.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a task by setting its status back to 'New'.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Moves or reorders a task within a list or between statuses/stages.
